Source: the founder's end-to-end walkthrough and 62-item finalised list, handed over from a prior conversation. Covers Part A (the shoot), Part B (content, in order), Part C (completion), Part D (travelling kit, later). Begins at contract signature; the sale itself is the follower app and is explicitly next, not here. 02-workflow / 03-expected-outputs / 05-impact deliberately NOT authored yet — the founder asked for analysis and mockups first, and sizing before the shape is agreed would be guessing.

audit_2026_08_15.verdict: The founder's read — 'almost everything before the shoot exists but is hidden inside the campaign, and almost everything after the shoot exists but nothing connects' — is accurate. 30 of 62 items already work in code. Three claims needed correcting.
audit_2026_08_15.confirmed_as_claimed: Shoot plan auto-created on signature (contract.controller.js:478 -> autoCreateForContract). Three modes (VALID_MODES). Propose/counter/accept/flip-to-remote/complete — six live routes. Two reschedules per side (RESCHEDULE_LIMIT_PER_SIDE, enforced both sides). Visit finishes 2 days before posting, worked backwards (getVisitDateRange: posting_date-2d, falling back to content_end_date-3d, campaign.end_date-3d, then a deliberate 1-year ceiling for the open-ended sales campaigns Part 5 introduced). Admin production queue (GET /admin/production/queue). Social chain submit->review->post->confirm-live->auto-scrape complete incl. refresh-stats. No wallet/escrow/payment stage anywhere in the sales track.
audit_2026_08_15.correction_1_media_library: ITEM 42 IS LISTED 'TO BUILD'. IT IS CLOSER TO 'CHANGES'. Migration 136 already created creator_assets — r2_key, media_type, aspect, an approval state, and foreign keys to BOTH campaign_influencer_id AND deliverable_id. Its own COMMENT reads 'approved creator photos, reusable across experiences'. 0 rows in prod, flag-gated behind CREATOR_IMAGERY (default off), one consumer (creatorImagery.service.js) built for per-context product imagery rather than shoot footage. So the media library is an EXTENSION of something already designed for reuse. Extending vs building beside it is a real call: creator_assets carries an approval workflow shoot footage does not need, and extending couples this work to the parked Creator Imagery program.
audit_2026_08_15.correction_2_where_it_is_buried: Buried in the CONTRACT screen, not the campaign. Production renders inside ContractScreen.js (creator) and BrandContractScreen.js (brand), and there are ZERO production routes in either navigator. Item 7 is therefore slightly larger than 'move a screen' — there is no screen to move, and no destination a notification can deep-link to.
audit_2026_08_15.correction_3_never_exercised: THE WHOLE SURFACE HAS RUN EXACTLY ONCE. Prod: production_events = 1 row (mode visit, status 'proposed' — never confirmed, never completed); contracts.production_mode = 1 (visit); creator_posts = 1 (approved); deliverables = 1 (live); creator_assets = 0. 'Works today' means the code paths exist and are wired, NOT that they have been exercised. Every works-today item should be read as code-verified and field-unproven.
audit_2026_08_15.new_work_confirmed_by_absence: Parcel contents + item receipt: no item/parcel/contents column in migration 024 or 039. Shop-live-before-social ordering: ZERO references to creator posts in deliverable.controller.js — the two tracks do not know each other exists. Brand notified on exclusive posts: creatorPosts.service.js notifies the CREATOR ONLY on approval. Fixed rejection reasons: reject takes free-text req.body.reason -> reject_reason. Completion: nothing computes it across the two tracks.

tally: 30 work · 7 change · 18 to build · 4 deliberately not built · 3 later. The build concentrates in five places — the parcel, the ordering rule, the notification, the reasons list, and the completion picture — plus the screens to put them on.

judgement_calls_flagged.ordering_threshold: The shop-before-social gate fires on ONE live shop post, not all of them. Requiring every post to clear review would let a single slow review hold her Instagram hostage, and the rule exists only so traffic lands somewhere. Founder may want all — flagged, not assumed silently.
judgement_calls_flagged.engagement_exemption: Engagement collaborations have no shop posts, so the gate must not accidentally block a paid reel. Needs an explicit test, not an intention.
judgement_calls_flagged.media_library_extend_vs_new: Recommended: extend creator_assets with the approval state made optional — shoot footage enters pending and is usable in a draft immediately, approval stays meaningful only where CREATOR_IMAGERY is on. Couples this work to a parked program, so it is the founder's call.
judgement_calls_flagged.delivered_at_approval: Completion is computed from the approval event, never from current visibility — so a post going dark (stock-out, price rise, offer expiry) never makes the creator non-compliant. Items 46/47.
